provenance: Recorded real model answers, deterministic virtual-clock replay; not a fresh live browser run, not an oracle.

methodology.cacheScope: empty at each seed, then exact-note memory/inflight reuse
methodology.latencies: recorded cold wall time plus replayed two-slot queue; failures/outage advance the clock and retain provisional dispatch
methodology.events: fixed known physical scenario shared by both banks; only JEV policy response uses recorded event interpretation after its measured delay
methodology.score: truth labels used only for scoring and physical capacity; ongoing waits counted at horizon; afterDrain phase stops arrivals and drains up to 600s; unfinished counts remain explicit if the cap is reached
caveats: 16 held-out random traffic seeds reuse the existing authored request corpus; they are not independent natural-language generalization tests.
The initial 16-wording development fixture exposed bugs and was used to revise guards; only the separate final 14-wording holdout remains a generalization check. Neither is clinical validation.
Service concurrency and measured cold latency are replayed approximations; load-dependent model latency and browser transport need a separate live run.
No guarantee of per-scenario or per-passenger improvement is implied; every regressed seed is retained.

attribution.note: The evidence-only arm never invokes an interpreter or applies semantic event policies. Its gains come from direct text evidence and dispatcher rules, not model inference. Compare other scenarios with this arm to identify incremental model benefit or harm. The outage arm separately checks failure behavior.
